plain: Loss of good name; being looked down on by others.

webster.text: Loss or want of reputation; disesteem; discredit; dishonor.

example.quote: Again: it is no less obvious that the intent to defame, or bring into contempt, or disrepute, or hatred,—which is made a condition of the offence created by the act,—cannot prevent its pernicious influence on the freedom of the press.
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
